title: Massive Israeli Detonation in Khiam Damages Marjayoun School, Blacks Out Three Districts
detail: A powerful Israeli military detonation in Khiam overnight (Sep 22–23) sent a shockwave across the surrounding area, breaking windows and cracking walls in Jdeidet Marjayoun and Qlayaa and damaging the Marjayoun National School badly enough that its administration suspended classes to replace shattered windows. The blast also caused a complete power blackout across the Hasbaya, Shebaa and Arqoub districts. No casualties were reported.

media.caption: Israeli detonation in Khiam damages a school in Marjayoun and blacks out three districts, Sep 23, 2026

title: EU Adopts €505 Million Support Package for Lebanon's Recovery and Reforms
detail: The European Commission announced €505 million in support for Lebanon covering 2026–2027 — the second half of the €1 billion pledge President von der Leyen made during her May 2024 visit to Beirut. The package funds institutional and security-sector reform, economic recovery and border management, and essential services (education, health, social protection and cash assistance) for vulnerable and displaced families, alongside support for sustainable solutions for Syrian refugees. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said 'a strong and stable Lebanon is fundamental for long-term peace in the Middle East.'

media.caption: EU adopts a €505 million support package for Lebanon's stability, recovery and reforms, Sep 23, 2026
